independence: The triage agent wrote none of the guides and did not run a walkthrough. It changed no guide text.
commands: git rev-list --no-merges <merge>^1..<merge> (for each first-parent merge, to map commits to pull requests)
git diff 432dba3a835863091791fbac429a6a66777bdc40..HEAD -- <per-file inspections named in candidates[].inspectedFiles>
git show -s --format=%b <commit> (commit messages of the direct commits and feature commits cited)
git show 432dba3a835863091791fbac429a6a66777bdc40:apps/web/src/routes/contract-record.tsx (card placement before the change)
method: I listed the application diff from 432dba3a and from 3fa407e3 and mapped every commit to its first-parent pull request or marked it a direct commit on dev. I grouped the files by product area with path rules and read the commit messages and diffs for each area. For each compatibility candidate I read the guide and its evidence sources, diffed the sources, and opened the code behind every claim that a change could reach. The 3fa407e3 to 432dba3a range was already reviewed for all 23 candidates in DOC-029 compat round 2 and round 3 (all compatible); its app files are listed under priorRange and I checked only whether any of them was touched again. For the 39 group articles I matched the guide's sections to the changes in this range.
